L01.text: A demo on Avalanche Fuji testnet: test USDC, and rounds sped up to about two minutes.
L01.spoken: A demo on Avalanche Fuji testnet: test U.S.D.C., and rounds sped up to about two minutes.

L02.text: Across Vietnam, families save through hụi.
L02.spoken: Across Vietnam, families save through hụi.

L03.text: Each month, everyone puts in, and one person takes the pot.
L03.spoken: Each month, everyone puts in, and one person takes the pot.

L04.text: In between, one person holds all of it: the organizer.
L04.spoken: In between, one person holds all of it: ... the organizer.

L05.text: Bình Thuận, 2024: over a hundred billion dong, from 167 people.
L05.spoken: Binh Thuan, twenty twenty-four: over a hundred billion dong, from one hundred sixty-seven people.

L06.text: Trà Vinh, 2025: 157 fake shares, and twelve years in prison.
L06.spoken: Tra Vinh, twenty twenty-five: one hundred fifty-seven fake shares, and twelve years in prison.

L07.text: Tây Ninh, 2026: fake Zalo accounts, nearly five hundred million dong.
L07.spoken: Tay Ninh, twenty twenty-six: fake Zalo accounts, nearly five hundred million dong.

L08.text: An organizer has two jobs: hold the money, and cover anyone who stops paying.
L08.spoken: An organizer has two jobs: hold the money, and cover anyone who stops paying.

L09.spoken: Hooey Safe keeps only the second.

L10.text: Money stays in each member's wallet until payout. The organizer locks a bond in a smart contract.
L10.spoken: Money stays in each member's wallet until payout. The organizer locks a bond in a smart contract.

L11.text: Sign in with Google and you have a wallet. No AVAX needed: our relayer pays the fees.
L11.spoken: Sign in with Google and you have a wallet. No Avax needed: our relayer pays the fees.

L12.text: The organizer sets up a circle: five members, ten USDC a round.
L12.spoken: The organizer sets up a circle: five members, ten U.S.D.C. a round.

L13.text: A forty-eight USDC bond brings coverage to one hundred percent, the minimum to start.
L13.spoken: A forty-eight U.S.D.C. bond brings coverage to one hundred percent, the minimum to start.

L14.text: One hundred percent coverage means the bond can absorb the worst single shock: everyone already paid stops paying at the same time.
L14.spoken: One hundred percent coverage means the bond can absorb the worst single shock: everyone already paid stops paying at the same time.

L15.text: Members sign once, allowing at most 40.40 USDC to be pulled. The money stays in their wallets.
L15.spoken: Members sign once, allowing at most forty point four zero U.S.D.C. to be pulled. The money stays in their wallets.

L16.text: Want the pot early? Bid a discount for the others, sealed and capped under Decree 19: 0.65 USDC this round.
L16.spoken: Want the pot early? Bid a discount for the others, sealed and capped under Decree nineteen: zero point six five U.S.D.C. this round.

L18.text: When time's up, the organizer opens the round.
L18.spoken: When time's up, the organizer opens the round.

L19.text: One transaction collects every share and pays Member 4: 28.848 USDC.
L19.spoken: One transaction collects every share and pays Member four: ... twenty-eight point eight four eight U.S.D.C..

L20.text: Another eight USDC are held back, in case Member 4 stops paying.
L20.spoken: Another eight U.S.D.C. are held back, in case Member four stops paying.

L21.text: Round two. Member 4 comes up ten USDC short.
L21.spoken: Round two. ... Member four comes up ten U.S.D.C. short.

L22.text: The same transaction covers it: eight from Member 4's holdback, two from the bond.
L22.spoken: The same transaction covers it: eight from Member four's holdback, two from the bond.

L23.text: Member 1 still gets the full 32.318 USDC.
L23.spoken: Member one still gets the full thirty-two point three one eight U.S.D.C..

L24.text: From round three, the bond covers Member 4's share: forty-eight USDC down to sixteen.
L24.spoken: From round three, the bond covers Member four's share: forty-eight U.S.D.C. down to sixteen.

L25.text: Every step goes into the ledger, linked to a transaction anyone can open.
L25.spoken: Every step goes into the ledger, linked to a transaction anyone can open.

L26.text: It runs on Avalanche Fuji: five verified contracts, 634 tests, and an internal review with no critical or high issues.
L26.spoken: It runs on Avalanche Fuji: five verified contracts, six hundred thirty-four tests, and an internal review with no critical or high issues.

L27.text: On November 20, an organizer ran a full circle from the web. The contract's balance ended at zero.
L27.spoken: On November 20, an organizer ran a full circle from the web. The contract's balance ended at zero.

L28.text: Why on-chain? So nobody holds the money, and the rules can't change mid-circle.
L28.spoken: Why on-chain? So nobody holds the money, and the rules can't change mid-circle.

L29.text: Why Avalanche? Transactions settle in about a second, native USDC with permit means one signature, and fees are low enough for us to pay them.
L29.spoken: Why Avalanche? Transactions settle in about a second, native U.S.D.C. with permit means one signature, and fees are low enough for us to pay them.

L30.text: Where does the money come from? Only the members' own savings: no token, nothing minted, no promised yield. The organizer earns a commission kept under Decree 19's interest cap.
L30.spoken: Where does the money come from? Only the members' own savings: no token, nothing minted, no promised yield. The organizer earns a commission kept under Decree nineteen's interest cap.

L31.text: The hụi you already know, with no one sitting on the pot. HụiSafe. Try it on Fuji testnet.
L31.spoken: The hụi you already know, with no one sitting on the pot. ... Hụi Safe. ... Try it on Fuji testnet.
